text: 2026全球开发者先锋大会暨（GDPS）国际具身智能技能大赛媒体通气会在上海举行。记者在现场获悉，大会将于10月23日至25日在上海张江科学会堂举办。
text_en: The 2026 Global Developer Pioneer Conference and the GDPS International Embodied Intelligence Skills Competition media briefing was held in Shanghai. Reporters learned at the scene that the conference will be held at the Zhangjiang Science Hall in Shanghai from October 23 to 25.
